main.node: Code - choose extraction source per part
MySQL - claim one pending chunk job

parameters.query:
DELETE FROM infofee01_rag.if_chunks
WHERE TextUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1);

INSERT INTO infofee01_rag.if_chunks
(
    ChunkUUIDBin,
    ChunkDatum,
    ChunkLetzterBearbeiterNr,
    TextUUIDBin,
    ChunkSprache,
    ChunkChunkNumber,
    ChunkText,
    ChunkPageFrom,
    ChunkPageTo
)
VALUES
(
    UUID_TO_BIN_MDB(UUID()),
    NOW(),
    0,
    UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1),
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6
);

SELECT
    p.PartID,
    p.QueueID,
    BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(p.TextUUIDBin) AS TextUUID,
    p.PartNumber,
    p.PageFrom,
    p.PageTo,
    p.Extractor,
    p.DoclingJSON,
    p.DoclingMD,
    p.PaddleJSON
FROM infofee01_rag.if_extraction_parts p
WHERE p.QueueID = $1
  AND p.Status = 'done'
ORDER BY p.PartNumber ASC;

nodes.name: MySQL - claim one pending chunk job

parameters.query:
SELECT
    cq.ChunkQueueID,
    cq.QueueID,
    BIN_TO_UUID_MDB(cq.TextUUIDBin) AS TextUUID,
    cq.Attempts
FROM infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue cq
WHERE cq.Status = 'pending'
ORDER BY cq.CreatedAt ASC
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue
SET
    Status = 'processing',
    StartedAt = NOW(),
    FinishedAt = NULL,
    Attempts = Attempts + 1,
    LastError = NULL
WHERE ChunkQueueID = $1
  AND Status = 'pending';

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue
SET
    Status = 'done',
    FinishedAt = NOW(),
    LastError = NULL
WHERE ChunkQueueID = $1
  AND Status = 'processing';

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue
SET
    Status = 'failed',
    LastError = $1,
    FinishedAt = NOW()
WHERE ChunkQueueID = $2
  AND Status = 'processing';

SELECT
    ChunkQueueID,
    Attempts,
    LastError
FROM infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue
WHERE ChunkQueueID = $1;

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue
SET
    Status = 'pending',
    StartedAt = NULL,
    FinishedAt = NULL,
    LastError = CONCAT(
        'RETRY: ',
        IFNULL(LastError, 'unknown error')
    )
WHERE ChunkQueueID = $1
  AND Status = 'failed';

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue
SET
    Status = 'dead_letter',
    FinishedAt = NOW(),
    LastError = CONCAT(
        IFNULL(LastError, 'unknown error'),
        ' | DEAD_LETTER: exceeded 3 attempts'
    )
WHERE ChunkQueueID = $1
  AND Status = 'failed';

UPDATE infofee01_rag.if_chunk_queue
SET
    Status = 'pending',
    LastError = CONCAT(
        IFNULL(LastError, ''),
        CASE
            WHEN LastError IS NULL OR LastError = ''
                THEN ''
            ELSE ' | '
        END,
        'STALE_PROCESSING_RECOVERY: chunk worker did not finish'
    ),
    StartedAt = NULL,
    FinishedAt = NULL
WHERE Status = 'processing'
  AND StartedAt < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS ActualChunks
FROM infofee01_rag.if_chunks
WHERE TextUUIDBin = UUID_TO_BIN_MDB($1);
